battle.name: 蜂蜜戰爭
battle.brief: 一八三九年夏，密蘇里州卡霍卡的稅吏越境到今愛荷華州收稅，被持草叉的居民趕走，傳說他們為抵稅砍了三棵蜂樹；克拉克縣警長被愛荷華方面拘留，兩州民兵在邊界上對峙，一發子彈未發。卡面輪發手槍屬民兵祖傳的那一代，真正的武器是乾草叉、犁刀與六尺長的鐵片劍。最後由聯邦最高法院定界。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 這場衝突的兩邊不是國家，而是同一個聯邦裡的一個州與一個準州。密蘇里州一八二〇年加入聯邦，州議會握有解釋邊界的權力，州長利爾本·博格斯是唯一可以直接調動民兵的人；愛荷華領地一八三八年才從密執根分出成立，總督羅伯特·盧卡斯是當地唯一有權號召民兵的人。兩邊的指揮系統都極其簡陋：密蘇里州民兵第十四師團由少將戴維·威洛克率領，愛荷華領地的民兵則由各縣臨時召集，沒有統一編制、沒有常備軍，也沒有像樣的軍械供應；第三支力量是聯邦政府，可是一八三九年它正忙於第二次塞米諾爾戰爭而無兵可派，於是聯邦剩下的角色只有測量總監局、國會與最高法院。行政上的界線爭端在稅務上爆開：密蘇里州的稅吏照章到愛荷華收稅，愛荷華的居民不認這條線，兩邊各派警員與民兵，最後連稅務官都被關進對方的監獄。整場衝突因此是一場純粹的州權與領地權之爭，沒有外交、沒有正規軍，也沒有宣戰。
countriesEn: The two sides of this conflict were not countries but a state and a territory inside the same federation. Missouri had entered the Union in 1820, its legislature held the right to interpret the boundary, and Governor Lilburn Boggs was the one man who could call out the militia directly; the Iowa Territory had only been separated from Michigan and organised in 1838, and Governor Robert Lucas was the only authority there able to summon armed men. The command systems on both sides were crude. The Missouri State Militia's 14th Division was led by Major General David Willock, while the Iowa militia was raised ad hoc by county with no common organisation, no standing army and no workable supply of arms; the third party was the federal government, which in 1839 was busy with the Second Seminole War and had no troops to spare, leaving the Surveyor General, Congress and the Supreme Court as its only roles. The administrative dispute broke open through taxation: Missouri's tax agents went into Iowa to collect what the law required, the Iowans did not accept that line, each side sent sheriffs and militia, and in the end a tax collector was held in the other side's jail. The whole affair was therefore a pure question of state against territory, with no diplomacy, no regular army and no declaration of war.
people: 密蘇里州長利爾本·博格斯是發動方，他派民兵第十四師團的一隊騎兵到爭議地帶去護稅；領隊的少將戴維·威洛克明確不願為這樣的事流血，這個立場把衝突壓在「對峙」而未至「交火」的界線上。愛荷華領地總督羅伯特·盧卡斯下令召集民兵，把事情升級到州與領地的層級。直接捲入的兩個人物是密蘇里州克拉克縣警長烏里亞·格里高利，人稱「桑迪」，他在爭議地帶收稅時被愛荷華方面的警長抓走，關在麥斯卡廷的監獄裡；另一方是那批稅吏，說法是他們為抵稅砍下三棵空心蜂樹取蜜，那三棵樹的地點如今在萊西—基奧索奎亞州立公園一帶。此外還有測量員在場：一八一六年為印第安納界線做測量的約翰·沙利文留下了「沙利文線」，一八三七年密蘇里州議會下令重測，測量員布朗故意採用德梅因河上的所謂急流，把起點定在今日基奧索奎亞一線，兩邊的爭議正是從這份測量報告裡生出來的。
peopleEn: Missouri Governor Lilburn Boggs was the man who started it, sending a mounted party of the 14th Division of the state militia down to the disputed ground to protect the tax collector; the officer in command, Major General David Willock, was plainly unwilling to shed blood over such a matter, and that attitude held the conflict on the line between a stand-off and a shooting. Iowa Territory Governor Robert Lucas called out the militia and raised the business to the level of state against territory. Two people were directly involved: the sheriff of Clark County, Missouri, Uriah Gregory, known as Sandy, who was taken by the Iowa side while collecting taxes in the disputed area and jailed in the Muscatine jail; and the tax agents themselves, who by the story going round cut down three hollow trees full of bees and took the honey in part payment of what they were owed, a grove that now lies in the neighbourhood of Lacey-Keosauqua State Park. Surveyors were involved as well: John C. Sullivan surveyed the Indian Boundary Line in 1816 and left the line that bears his name, and in 1837 the Missouri legislature ordered a resurvey, in which the surveyor J.C. Brown deliberately took the rapids on the Des Moines itself and fixed the starting point at Keosauqua, several miles inside what is now Iowa. The dispute was born out of that report.
kits: 卡面這件輪發手槍在這場衝突裡的位置很特別：它屬於「祖傳」那一代，也就是民兵口袋裡的古物，而不是任何一方的制式裝備。關於愛荷華民兵武裝的記述很有名：隊伍裡有喇叭口槍、燧發步槍和祖傳的舊劍，有人拿著用鍊條挑著的犁刀，有人帶著老式灌腸器當武器，還有人扛著一把約六尺長的鐵片劍。密蘇里州那一隊騎兵則是民兵編制裡少數還算像樣的部分，配步槍與手槍，馬匹由各人自備。整場衝突裡真正動用的工具是斧頭、繩鍊、測量用的鐵鍈與車，而不是火器；沒有一門炮，沒有一箱彈藥，兩邊也沒有共用任何一種口徑的制式步槍，因為民兵各自從家裡帶傢伙。這正說明一八三〇年代美國邊疆民兵的本質：它不是軍隊，是一羣帶著農具上路的鄉民，卡面那件十六世紀的手槍，在這樣的隊伍裡自然只是一件傳家之物。
kitsEn: The wheellock pistol on this card has a peculiar place in this conflict: it belongs to the heirloom generation, the family piece carried in a militiaman's pocket, and is the issued weapon of neither side. The description of the Iowa militia's arms is famous: in the ranks were found blunderbusses, flintlocks and quaint old ancestral swords that had probably adorned walls for generations; one man carried a plough coulter over his shoulder by means of a log chain, another had an old-fashioned sausage stuffer for a weapon, and a third shouldered a sheet-iron sword about six feet long. The Missouri party of mounted men was the part of the militia that still looked like soldiers, with muskets and pistols and horses of their own. The tools actually used in the whole affair were axes, rope, the surveyor's chain and wagons, not firearms; there was no cannon, there was no ammunition wagon, and the two sides shared no common calibre of musket, because every militiaman brought what his own house could provide. That is the nature of the American frontier militia of the 1830s: it was not an army but a company of countrymen on the road with their farm tools, and a sixteenth-century pistol in such a column is naturally a family relic rather than an arm.
tactics: 所謂戰術，在這場戰爭裡其實是幾個動作的疊加。第一步是越界收稅：密蘇里州的稅吏自卡霍卡出發，進入今日愛荷華州的範伯倫縣與戴維斯縣，向居民徵稅；居民手持草叉把稅吏趕走，傳說稅吏以砍下蜂樹取蜜抵稅。第二步是報復與拘留：愛荷華方面反過來把密蘇里州克拉克縣警長格里高利抓走，關在麥斯卡廷的監獄裡，州與領地之間的對抗從口角變成互相扣人。第三步是民兵對峙：博格斯州長派十一名騎兵到邊界保護稅吏，威洛克不願開火，愛荷華民兵也奉盧卡斯之命集結，兩隊人在邊界線上隔地相望，沒有射擊、沒有衝鋒、沒有任何陣形可言。最後一步是把它交給法理：兩州州長同意讓國會處理，兩軍之間先劃了一條臨時中線，爭議於是從邊境回到議事廳與法院。一場沒有戰鬥的戰爭，最後靠測量報告、法條與判例收場，這在美國西部史上是罕見的先例。
tacticsEn: What passes for tactics in this war is really a sequence of moves. First the collection of taxes across the line: the Missouri tax agents set out from Kahoka, entered what are now Van Buren and Davis Counties in Iowa and levied on the inhabitants; the inhabitants chased them off with pitchforks, and the story is that the agents cut down the bee trees and took the honey in lieu of payment. Then retaliation and detention: Iowans seized the sheriff of Clark County, Missouri, Uriah Gregory, and locked him in the Muscatine jail, and the quarrel between state and territory turned from words into mutual hostage-taking. Then the stand-off of the militias: Governor Boggs sent eleven mounted men to the border to protect the collector, Willock would not fire, the Iowa militia was assembled on Lucas's order, and the two parties faced each other across the line without a shot, a charge or any formation worth the name. Finally the matter was handed to law: the two governors agreed to let Congress settle it, and an arbitrary line was drawn between the positions of the two sides in the meantime, so the dispute left the border for the legislative hall and the court. A war without a battle ended with a survey, a statute and a judgment, which is a rare precedent in the history of the American West.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。爭議的是一條沿兩州邊界全長延伸、寬約九點五英里（約十五點三公里）的狹長地帶；一八二〇年密蘇里州憲法對北界線的措辭含糊，一八二四年薩克與福克斯族割讓的「混血地帶」位置也與後來的解釋有出入，一八一六年的沙利文線自堪薩斯城附近的堪薩斯河口一路量到謝里丹，再東至德梅因河。事件本身：一八三九年密蘇里州稅吏團的人數不詳，只留下砍倒三棵蜂樹的說法；克拉克縣警長一人被拘留並關在麥斯卡廷；密蘇里州民兵出動十一名騎兵，隸屬第十四師團，由帕爾邁拉出發；愛荷華領地民兵奉總督之命集結；州議會為七天的動員核撥經費共四十六美元。傷亡為零，通稱一場不流血的邊界爭端。司法結果：一八四六年愛荷華加入聯邦，一八四九年最高法院在密蘇里州訴愛荷華州案（48 U.S. 660）中判愛荷華勝訴，確認沙利文線為正確邊界並下令重測；今日的邊界在基奧克一帶仍保留一段約三十英里的凸出。現存檔案只把事件記在一八三九年，具體日子多已不可考，一般敘述把它放在夏季。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. What was in dispute was a narrow strip, about nine and a half miles wide (15.3 km) and running the whole length of the border; the wording of the Missouri constitution of 1820 about the northern line was ambiguous, and the position of the Half Breed Tract ceded by the Sac and Fox in 1824 did not fit every later reading; the Sullivan Line of 1816 ran from the mouth of the Kansas River near Kansas City, Missouri, to about Sheridan, Missouri, and then east to the Des Moines near Farmington, Iowa. The incident itself: the number of Missouri tax agents is not recorded, only the story of the three bee trees felled; one sheriff, of Clark County, was detained in the Muscatine jail; eleven mounted men of the Missouri State Militia's 14th Division marched from Palmyra, Missouri; the Iowa militia was assembled on the governor's order; and the legislature authorised a total of forty-six dollars for the militia for seven days in active service. There were no casualties, and it is known as a bloodless boundary dispute. The legal outcome: Iowa entered the Union in 1846, and in 1849 the Supreme Court decided State of Missouri v. State of Iowa, 48 U.S. 660, in Iowa's favour, holding up the Sullivan Line as the correct border and ordering it resurveyed; the jog of nearly thirty miles in the border at Keokuk survives to this day. The surviving records fix the year only as 1839; the exact dates are mostly lost, and the season is generally given as summer.
cause: 起因是三八〇年代一連串測量與條約留下的模糊地帶。第一是憲法的措辭：一八二〇年密蘇里州加入聯邦時，北界線以「德梅因河上的急流」定位，但德梅因河本身並無急流，真正有急流的是密西西比河上的德梅因急流，兩處相距甚遠，後來的解讀各取所需。第二是測量的偶然：一八一六年約翰·沙利文主持的印第安納界線測量自堪薩斯河口起算，把接壤點定在今日法姆ington附近的德梅因河；一八三七年密蘇里州議會要求重測，測量員布朗卻在德梅因河上另找急流，把起點推到今日基奧索奎亞，即今日愛荷華州境內九點五英里處，兩州的主張因此正面對撞。第三是條約的誤讀：一八〇四年聖路易斯條約、一八〇八年福特克拉克條約與一八一五年波塔熱·德索鳩條約所劃的「混血地帶」，一方認為是讓出的土地，另一方認為只是部族之間的安排。壓上最後一根稻草的是日常行政：稅要照收，州政府的開支要靠它，於是收稅的稅吏站到了前線，爭議也從地圖上落到人身上，而人是可以被逮捕的。
causeEn: The cause lies in a stretch of vagueness left by a decade of surveying and treaty-making in the 1830s. First, the wording of the constitution: when Missouri was admitted in 1820 its northern boundary was fixed at the rapids on the river Des Moines, but the Des Moines has no rapids at all, while the Mississippi nearby has the Des Moines Rapids, and the two places are far apart; later readings took whichever suited. Second, the accident of survey: in 1816 John C. Sullivan surveyed the Indian Boundary Line from the mouth of the Kansas River and fixed the junction near Farmington, Iowa; in 1837 the Missouri legislature ordered a resurvey, and the surveyor Brown went looking for rapids on the Des Moines itself and put the starting point at Keosauqua, nine and a half miles inside modern Iowa, so that the claims of the two states collided head on. Third, the misreading of treaties: the Half Breed Tract defined by the Treaty of St. Louis of 1804, the Treaty of Fort Clark of 1808 and the Treaties of Portage des Sioux of 1815 was understood by one side as land already ceded and by the other as an arrangement between tribes. The last straw was ordinary administration: the taxes had to be collected, the state needed the money, and so the tax agent stood in the front line; the argument moved from the map onto the person, and a person can be arrested.
impact: 後果分兩層。第一層是法律與地圖：一八四九年最高法院的判例把沙利文線定為正確邊界，命令重測並清除原線的曲折；一八四六年愛荷華建州時沿用的正是這條線，今日愛荷華與密蘇里之間那段約三十英里的凸出，以及基奧克一帶作為全州最低點的著名地形，都是那次判例與後續測量的產物。密蘇里州二〇〇五年再委託重測，發現沿線不少標記仍是一八五〇年那次重測留下的；蜂蜜戰爭的紀念碑至今立於謝里丹以北的邊界上。第二層是政治文化：這場不流血的邊界衝突成為美國西部州權與領地權之爭的原型，它把「稅吏能不能跨線收稅」這種日常問題變成主權問題，也讓人記住民兵可以在一夜之間集結、卻不必開槍也解決不了什麼；後來德克薩斯與愛荷華一類領地衝突裡「先集結、後談判」的套路，源頭都可以追到一八三九年這幾個星期。而它最持久的遺產其實是個笑話：把一場邊界爭執叫做蜂蜜戰爭，本身就說明那段記憶有多好講、好傳、好記，據說近年還有人專程到那片林地去找那三棵早已不存在的蜂樹。
impactEn: The consequences came in two layers. The first was legal and cartographic: the judgment of 1849 fixed the Sullivan Line as the correct border and ordered it resurveyed to correct its quirks, and it was that line which Iowa took into the Union in 1846; the jog of nearly thirty miles in the modern border and the famous position of Keokuk as the state's lowest point are both products of that judgment and the surveys that followed. Missouri commissioned a further resurvey in 2005 and found that many of the markers on the ground still date from the resurvey of 1850, and the monument commemorating the Honey War stands today north of Sheridan, Missouri. The second layer was political culture: this bloodless boundary quarrel became the prototype of the state-versus-territory disputes of the American West. It turned the everyday question of whether a tax collector might cross the line to collect a tax into a question of sovereignty, and it left behind the knowledge that a militia can be assembled overnight and still settle nothing without a shot; the habit of mustering first and negotiating afterwards, seen later in contests over Texas and Iowa, traces back to these few weeks of 1839. The most durable legacy, though, is a joke: calling a boundary dispute the Honey War is itself proof of how well the story travels, and word has it that people still go looking for the three bee trees that no longer exist.
result: 結果是一場沒有勝負的勝負。全程沒有開過一槍，沒有陣亡，沒有俘虜：稅吏被草叉趕走，蜂樹被砍倒三棵，警長被關進對方監獄又獲釋，民兵在邊界站了幾天，最後兩位州長同意把事情交給國會，兩軍之間先劃了一條臨時線。正式的收尾分兩步：一八四六年愛荷華加入聯邦時，國會把北界線定在德梅因河與密西西比河的交會處；一八四九年最高法院在密蘇里州訴愛荷華州案中判愛荷華勝訴，理由是密蘇里州十年以上未對沙利文線提出異議，因而認定該線有效，同時下令重測以修正原線的曲折。結果是愛荷華保住了一條比原先主張更東的邊界，密蘇里放棄了德梅因河急流一說。這場戰爭從頭到尾沒有決定戰局的兵器：卡面那件十六世紀的輪發手槍，留在民兵家中的壁爐旁；真正決定結果的是測量員的尺、法官的判例與兩位州長的克制。
resultEn: The result was a victory with nothing to fight over. Not one shot was fired, nobody was killed, nobody was taken prisoner: the tax agents were chased off with pitchforks, three bee trees were cut down, the sheriff was locked up in the other side's jail and released, the militias stood on the border for a few days, and finally the two governors agreed to refer the matter to Congress, an arbitrary line being drawn between the two positions in the meantime. The formal conclusion came in two steps. When Iowa was admitted in 1846, Congress set the northern boundary at the junction of the Des Moines and the Mississippi; and in 1849 the Supreme Court decided State of Missouri v. State of Iowa in Iowa's favour, on the ground that Missouri had not challenged the straight Sullivan Line for more than ten years and had thereby acquiesced in it, while ordering a resurvey to correct the line's quirks. The upshot was that Iowa kept a boundary further east than the one it had first claimed and Missouri abandoned the rapids of the Des Moines. Nothing that was fired decided this war. The sixteenth-century wheellock on the card stayed by the hearth in some militiaman's house, and what settled the matter was the surveyor's chain, the judge's ruling and the restraint of two governors.
